newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stronger crown helps Swedish bond yields end lower.
newsitem.headline: Stronger crown helps Swedish bond yields end lower.

text.p: A firmer crown and stronger international markets helped Swedish bond yields end lower on Wednesday.

The crown firmed mainly on commercial flows as Swedish export companies bought the currency but also on strong fundamentals, dealers said. * Six-month T-bill rate falls three basis points to 4.22 pct * Ten-year bond yield drops three basis points to 7.11 pct * Crown firms to 4.5000 to mark vs 4.5315 late on Tuesday

STOCKHOLM, May 7 (Reuter) - A firmer crown and stronger international markets helped Swedish bond yields end lower on Wednesday. The market closed at 1000 GMT ahead of an Ascension Day holiday on Thursday.
The crown firmed mainly on commercial flows as Swedish export companies bought the currency but also on strong fundamentals, dealers said.

"There has not been any specific news to trade on," a dealer said. "The crown has been weak for quite some time and I suppose a lot of people think that strong Swedish fundamentals justify buying crowns."
The crown firmed to 4.5000 crowns against the mark from 4.5315 late on Tuesday.
The ten-year bond yield dropped three basis points to 7.11 percent while the six-month T-bill rate fell three basis points to 4.22 percent.
"It (the bond market) has been currency driven today," a trader said. "Also, Italy's lower house passed the mini-budget, which made Italian yields fall six to seven basis points."
The Swedish Finance Minister said it would take a few more weeks before the government disclosed its view on EMU membership. -- Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700 1017
